channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Ryan recalled by Limerick
item.description: Reigning Poc Fada champion Colin Ryan has been recalled to the Limerick senior hurling panel after a six-year absence.

item.title: Sligo man Murphy to run for GAA president
item.description: Sligo's John Murphy has joined Derek Kent (Wexford) and Ger Ryan (Tipperary) in the race to become the next GAA president.

item.title: Looney and Wall join AFLW exodus
item.description: Cork's Hannah Looney and Sarah Wall from Meath have become the latest ladies football stars to sign for AFLW clubs.

item.title: O'Neill joins Tyrone U20 management
item.description: Tyrone U20 football boss Paul Devlin has added Stephen O'Neill to his backroom team.

item.title: Morley welcomes Donaghy's Kerry return
item.description: Tadhg Morley has hailed the addition of Kieran Donaghy to the Kerry football management set-up as a 'great coup'.

item.title: 'Philly is a huge part of that group of players'
item.description: Niall Fitzgerald says his new Tipperary football charges are desperate to honour Philly Ryan's memory.

item.title: New Longford GAA Centre of Excellence will be open to other sports
item.description: Longford GAA will be making its proposed Centre of Excellence available to other sports.

item.title: 'I don't see him making wholesale changes'
item.description: Seán Óg Ó hAilpín doesn't foresee new Cork hurling manager Ben O'Connor making too many changes to the set-up.

item.title: Munster GAA keen to see minor restored to U18
item.description: Munster Council chairman Tim Murphy is hopeful the minor grade will be restored to U18 at inter-county level.

item.title: Louth and Down face off on New Year's Eve
item.description: The Louth and Down senior footballers will meet in the annual Jim McGeough Cup at the Geraldines GAA grounds on New Year's Eve.
